    {

      "end_ms": 5800,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U003",
      "voice": "voice_1",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"Why would you offer me your name?\"",
      "start_ms": 5900,
      "end_ms": 7700,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U004",
      "voice": "voice_2",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"Because I know what I see.\"",
      "start_ms": 8000,
      "end_ms": 10200,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U005",
      "voice": "voice_1",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"And what do you see?\"",
      "start_ms": 12100,
      "end_ms": 13700,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U006",
      "voice": "voice_2",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"A woman who was betrayed.\"",
      "start_ms": 14000,
      "end_ms": 16000,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U007",
      "voice": "voice_2",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"Not a woman who deserves to be discarded.\"",
      "start_ms": 16500,
      "end_ms": 18800,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U008",
      "voice": "voice_1",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"You don't know what my family has done to me.\"",
      "start_ms": 22000,
      "end_ms": 24800,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U009",
      "voice": "voice_2",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"I know they have made you stand alone.\"",
      "start_ms": 26000,
      "end_ms": 28800,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U010",
      "voice": "voice_2",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"You don't have to stand alone now.\"",
      "start_ms": 30000,
      "end_ms": 32500,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U011",
      "voice": "voice_1",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"If this is pity, take back your ring.\"",
      "start_ms": 33600,
      "end_ms": 35800,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U012",
      "voice": "voice_1",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"I will not become anyone's charity.\"",
      "start_ms": 36800,
      "end_ms": 38800,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U013",
      "voice": "voice_2",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"It is not pity, Lady Juliana.\"",
      "start_ms": 39500,
      "end_ms": 42500,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U014",
      "voice": "voice_2",
      "delivery": [],
      "text": "\"It is a vow.\"",
      "start_ms": 43500,
      "end_ms": 45500,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U015",
      "voice": "voice_1",
      "delivery": [
        "V.O."
      ],
      "text": "\"I don't know this man.\"",
      "start_ms": 46000,
      "end_ms": 48000,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
      "id": "U016",
      "voice": "voice_1",
      "delivery": [
        "V.O."
      ],
      "text": "\"I don't know what waits beyond these doors.\"",
      "start_ms": 48000,
      "end_ms": 49600,
      "complete_in_opener": false,
      "crosses_opener_unknown_prefix": false
    },
    {
